datasets.name: ds_history
queryLines: WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM ofs_loadtest_runs WHERE notebook = '03_locust_run'
ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT h.ts, h.phase, h.requests_per_s AS qps, h.p50_ms, h.p95_ms, h.p99_ms, h.user_count, h.failures_per_s,
CAST(FLOOR((unix_timestamp(h.ts) - MIN(unix_timestamp(h.ts)) OVER ()) / 10) * 10 AS INT) AS elapsed_s
FROM ofs_loadtest_history h JOIN latest USING (run_id)

datasets.name: ds_path_ladder
queryLines: WITH r0 AS (
SELECT * FROM ofs_loadtest_runs WHERE notebook = '05_stress' AND target_qps IS NOT NULL ),
runs AS (
SELECT run_id, CONCAT(date_format(MIN(started_at), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC · ', LEFT(run_id, 8), ' · ',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(lakebase_min_cu)) = 0 THEN 'sizes not recorded'
ELSE CONCAT('Lakebase ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(lakebase_min_cu AS INT), 'hi', CAST(lakebase_max_cu AS INT)))),
s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), CASE WHEN s.hi <> s.lo THEN CONCAT('-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING)) ELSE '' END)), '/'), ' CU',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(min_provisioned_concurrency)) = 0 THEN ''

ELSE CONCAT(' · FS ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(min_provisioned_concurrency AS INT), 'hi', CAST(max_provisioned_concurrency AS INT)))), s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), '-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING))), ', ')) END) END,
' · ', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT access_path) AS STRING), ' paths') AS run_label
FROM r0 GROUP BY run_id ),
r AS (SELECT r0.*, runs.run_label FROM r0 JOIN runs USING (run_id))

SELECT r.run_label, r.access_path, CONCAT(CASE r.access_path WHEN 'fs' THEN 'Feature Serving' WHEN 'dataapi' THEN 'Data API' WHEN 'pg' THEN 'Direct Postgres' WHEN 'pg_pooled' THEN 'Pooled Postgres' ELSE r.access_path END, ' · ', COALESCE(r.config, 'unlabelled')) AS series, r.config, CAST(r.target_qps AS INT) AS target_qps, r.qps AS achieved_qps,
r.p50_ms, r.p95_ms, r.p99_ms, r.failures, r.users AS connections, r.peak_inflight,
r.client_cpu, r.client_bound, r.slo_pass
FROM r

datasets.name: ds_path_menu
queryLines: WITH r0 AS (
SELECT * FROM ofs_loadtest_runs WHERE notebook = '05_stress' AND target_qps IS NOT NULL ),
runs AS (
SELECT run_id, CONCAT(date_format(MIN(started_at), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC · ', LEFT(run_id, 8), ' · ',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(lakebase_min_cu)) = 0 THEN 'sizes not recorded'
ELSE CONCAT('Lakebase ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(lakebase_min_cu AS INT), 'hi', CAST(lakebase_max_cu AS INT)))),
s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), CASE WHEN s.hi <> s.lo THEN CONCAT('-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING)) ELSE '' END)), '/'), ' CU',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(min_provisioned_concurrency)) = 0 THEN ''

ELSE CONCAT(' · FS ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(min_provisioned_concurrency AS INT), 'hi', CAST(max_provisioned_concurrency AS INT)))), s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), '-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING))), ', ')) END) END,
' · ', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT access_path) AS STRING), ' paths') AS run_label
FROM r0 GROUP BY run_id ),

r AS (SELECT r0.*, runs.run_label, CONCAT(CASE r0.access_path WHEN 'fs' THEN 'Feature Serving' WHEN 'dataapi' THEN 'Data API' WHEN 'pg' THEN 'Direct Postgres' WHEN 'pg_pooled' THEN 'Pooled Postgres' ELSE r0.access_path END, ' · ', COALESCE(r0.config, 'unlabelled')) AS series FROM r0 JOIN runs USING (run_id)),
stable AS (
SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, series ORDER BY target_qps DESC) AS rn
FROM r WHERE slo_pass ),
broke AS (SELECT run_id, series, CAST(MIN(target_qps) AS INT) AS first_unstable_qps FROM r
WHERE NOT slo_pass AND NOT COALESCE(client_bound, false) GROUP BY run_id, series),
keys AS (SELECT DISTINCT run_id, run_label, series FROM r)
SELECT k.run_label, k.series,
CASE WHEN s.target_qps IS NULL THEN NULL
WHEN b.first_unstable_qps IS NULL THEN CONCAT('≥', CAST(CAST(s.target_qps AS INT) AS STRING))
ELSE CAST(CAST(s.target_qps AS INT) AS STRING) END AS max_qps_within_slo,
s.p50_ms, s.p95_ms, s.p99_ms, s.users AS connections_at_max, b.first_unstable_qps
FROM keys k
LEFT JOIN stable s ON s.run_id = k.run_id AND s.series = k.series AND s.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN broke b ON b.run_id = k.run_id AND b.series = k.series
ORDER BY k.run_label, s.target_qps DESC NULLS LAST, s.p95_ms

datasets.name: ds_at_2k

queryLines: WITH r0 AS (
SELECT * FROM ofs_loadtest_runs WHERE notebook = '05_stress' AND target_qps IS NOT NULL ),
runs AS (
SELECT run_id, CONCAT(date_format(MIN(started_at), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' UTC · ', LEFT(run_id, 8), ' · ',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(lakebase_min_cu)) = 0 THEN 'sizes not recorded'
ELSE CONCAT('Lakebase ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(lakebase_min_cu AS INT), 'hi', CAST(lakebase_max_cu AS INT)))),
s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), CASE WHEN s.hi <> s.lo THEN CONCAT('-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING)) ELSE '' END)), '/'), ' CU',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(min_provisioned_concurrency)) = 0 THEN ''

ELSE CONCAT(' · FS ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(min_provisioned_concurrency AS INT), 'hi', CAST(max_provisioned_concurrency AS INT)))), s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), '-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING))), ', ')) END) END,
' · ', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT access_path) AS STRING), ' paths') AS run_label
FROM r0 GROUP BY run_id ),
r AS (SELECT r0.*, runs.run_label FROM r0 JOIN runs USING (run_id))

SELECT r.run_label, CASE r.access_path WHEN 'fs' THEN 'Feature Serving' WHEN 'dataapi' THEN 'Data API' WHEN 'pg' THEN 'Direct Postgres' WHEN 'pg_pooled' THEN 'Pooled Postgres' ELSE r.access_path END AS path_label, COALESCE(r.lakebase_min_cu, 0) AS lakebase_cu,
CASE WHEN r.access_path = 'fs' THEN CONCAT(CAST(r.min_provisioned_concurrency AS STRING), '-',
CAST(r.max_provisioned_concurrency AS STRING)) END AS fs_concurrency,
r.qps AS achieved_qps, r.p50_ms, r.p95_ms, r.p99_ms, r.failures, r.slo_pass
FROM r WHERE r.target_qps = 2000
ORDER BY r.run_label, r.p95_ms

ELSE CONCAT('Lakebase ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(lakebase_min_cu AS INT), 'hi', CAST(lakebase_max_cu AS INT)))),
s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), CASE WHEN s.hi <> s.lo THEN CONCAT('-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING)) ELSE '' END)), '/'), ' CU',
CASE WHEN size(collect_set(min_provisioned_concurrency)) = 0 THEN ''

ELSE CONCAT(' · FS ', array_join(transform(sort_array(collect_set(named_struct('lo', CAST(min_provisioned_concurrency AS INT), 'hi', CAST(max_provisioned_concurrency AS INT)))), s -> CONCAT(CAST(s.lo AS STRING), '-', CAST(s.hi AS STRING))), ', ')) END) END,
' · ', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT access_path) AS STRING), ' paths') AS run_label
FROM r0 GROUP BY run_id ),

SELECT run_label,

MIN(CASE WHEN access_path = 'pg' AND target_qps = 2000 AND slo_pass THEN p95_ms END) AS pg_p95_2k,
MIN(CASE WHEN access_path = 'pg_pooled' AND target_qps = 2000 AND slo_pass THEN p95_ms END) AS pooled_p95_2k,
MIN(CASE WHEN access_path = 'fs' AND target_qps = 2000 AND slo_pass THEN p95_ms END) AS fs_p95_2k,
MIN(CASE WHEN access_path = 'dataapi' AND target_qps = 2000 AND slo_pass THEN p95_ms END) AS dataapi_p95_2k
FROM r GROUP BY run_label
